_comment: Modular armor registry. Defines armor pieces, equipment slots ('helmet' | 'body' | 'necklace' | 'ring' | 'accessory'), weight classes ('light' | 'medium' | 'heavy' for true armor slots 'helmet' | 'body'; accessories/jewelry are pure stat items without weightClass), weights, flat HP bonuses, and per-item HP split ratio (default 50/50 across Main HP and Critical HP).

armors.name: Leather Cap
armors.description: A supple cap sewn from wolf pelts. Increases Max HP by 8 and Critical HP by 7.

armors.name: Leather Armor
armors.description: A stitched leather tunic reinforced with wolf hide. Increases Max HP by 13 and Critical HP by 12.

armors.name: Silk Cowl
armors.description: A tightly woven cowl spun from subterranean spider silk. Increases Max HP by 15 and Critical HP by 15.

armors.name: Silk Robe
armors.description: An enchanted, resilient robe woven from pure spider silk. Increases Max HP by 25 and Critical HP by 25.

armors.name: Bone Necklace
armors.description: A protective talisman strung with carved monster bones and durable cord. Increases Max HP by 10 and Critical HP by 10.

armors.name: Wolf Claw Ring
armors.description: A polished band crafted from sharp wolf claws and bone. Increases Max HP by 7 and Critical HP by 7.

armors.name: Venom Charm
armors.description: A resilient ward vial containing stabilized spider venom and silk. Increases Max HP by 13, Critical HP by 13, and Carry Capacity by 5kg.

armors.name: Voidforged Greathelm
armors.description: A monolithic greathelm beaten from dense void plate. Increases Max HP by 30 and Critical HP by 30.

armors.name: Voidforged Plate Armor
armors.description: An impenetrable suit of heavy void plate armor infused with otherworldly resilience. Increases Max HP by 50 and Critical HP by 50.

armors.name: Voidforged Pendant
armors.description: A dark crystalline talisman radiating pure planar wards. Increases Max HP by 20 and Critical HP by 20.

armors.name: Voidforged Band
armors.description: A heavy signet forged of void essence and steel. Increases Max HP by 14 and Critical HP by 14.

armors.name: Voidforged Relic
armors.description: A pulsating relic housing an epic void core. Increases Max HP by 25, Critical HP by 25, and Carry Capacity by 10kg.
